Id.description: Opaque stable external identifier. A displayed measure number, staff number, or event ordinal is not an identifier. External IDs are not automatically legal SFS aliases: use the returned alias/reference map and TextIdentifier for fragment-local names.

TextIdentifier.description: SFS lexical identifier used for a fragment-local voice alias or event ID. It is distinct from an opaque external score/revision/object identifier. The parser and returned binding map establish correspondence.

RevisionId.description: Immutable score revision identifier; never the mutable alias latest.

Rational.description: Exact canonical rational in quarter-note units where applicable. Integers have no denominator; fractions have positive denominator > 1. Semantic validation additionally requires gcd(abs(n), d)=1. JSON Schema alone cannot enforce reduction; 2/4 is rejected by the semantic validator. No floating-point JSON values, leading zeros, -0, 0/d, or n/1.

PositiveRational.description: Strictly positive canonical rational; requires the same reduction check as Rational.

NonNegativeRational.description: Nonnegative canonical rational; requires the same reduction check as Rational.

WrittenPitch.description: Canonical written pitch, e.g. C4, Db4, C##4, C(+1/2)4. Semantic checks enforce reduced alterations and the short forms for 0, +/-1 and +/-2 semitones. This is a spelling, not a printed accidental or a MIDI value.

ClockSpan.description: Half-open [start,end), with start < end verified semantically in the named score clock.

Actor.description: Output provenance derived from the authenticated desktop/MCP command context. Never accepted as caller-controlled mutation authority.
